presentation.label: FILTERS
presentation.summary: Two more filter TYPEs on the stock FLTR page: a one-knob DJ filter (low-pass one way, high-pass the other) and a band-pass.
presentation.overview: TYPE on the FLTR page goes past EQ:5 to DJ and BP. On DJ, FREQ left of the middle is a low-pass, right of it a high-pass, and the middle is open, with a short catch there when you turn quickly. BP is a 12 dB/octave band-pass whose width RESO sets. FREQ, RESO and ENV act as on the stock types and are saved with the sound, p-lockable and LFO-able.
highlights: DJ: one knob from low-pass through open to high-pass, with a catch in the middle.
BP: a band-pass at unity gain; RESO narrows it.
Saved with the sound, p-lockable and LFO-able, like the stock types.
usage: Select the track and press FLTR.
Turn TYPE (knob G) past EQ:5 to DJ.
Turn FREQ left of the middle for a low-pass, right of it for a high-pass; the middle is open.
Turn RESO up for a peak at the cutoff; FUNC + FREQ takes it back to open.

access.location: FLTR page > TYPE (knob G), past EQ:5
steps: Use a build with Filters on OS 1.54.
Press FLTR and turn knob G (TYPE) past EQ:5 to DJ, then BP.

controls.name: TYPE (FLTR page, knob G)
controls.doc: Adds DJ and BP after EQ:5.

controls.name: FREQ on DJ (knob E)
controls.doc: Below 64 a low-pass, above 64 a high-pass, 64 open. A quick turn across the middle stops there for about a quarter second; FUNC + FREQ jumps to the middle, then to the end.

controls.name: RESO on DJ and BP (knob F)
controls.doc: DJ: a gentle peak at the cutoff. BP: narrows the band.

limitations: Not beside Digi Health: both patch the render's per-voice filter call.
A sound saved with DJ or BP loads on a build without Filters as EQ:5.

load.display: No measurable extra load: DJ and BP replace the stock filter's work for their voices (emulator)
load.conditions: Emulator: OS 1.54 on Core 2.1, the demo pattern playing, 3,000 blocks with the MCF5441x timing model at 250 MHz, zero-wait memory. Core alone 60.3% mean, 62.0% worst block; with Filters on the stock types 60.3% and 62.1%; with DJ set on the tracks 59.9% and 61.5%; with BP 59.1% and 60.7% (TYPE set through the panel, calls into the new filter counted). Not a hardware measurement.

tests.summary: Emulator (digiemu, OS 1.54, FL01): TYPE reaches DJ and BP past EQ:5 and stops at BP; the page draws both; no measurable extra audio load. Hardware run of FL01 pending.
